notes: Sum of route_segments.csv RS001 only. Covers the Strait of Hormuz (CP001) to Deendayal Port (PORT001) leg. Does NOT cover Saudi Arabia (SUP001) to the Strait of Hormuz - no coordinate is sourced anywhere in this project for SUP001, the Persian Gulf, or the Gulf of Oman/Arabian Sea labels in route_nodes.csv, so that portion is not modelled and must not be assumed small or zero. This is a geodesic (great-circle) distance, not an actual maritime sailing distance. estimated_transit_days is NULL: no authoritative vessel-speed assumption exists in this project (see docs/data_sources.md); inventing one would fabricate a transit estimate this project has deliberately avoided since Phase 1.

Fewer than two coordinate-resolvable nodes exist in this route's route_nodes.csv chain: only the destination (PORT001) has a sourced coordinate. The origin (SUP003, United Arab Emirates) and the named export terminal 'Fujairah' carry no coordinate in suppliers.csv or anywhere else in this project, so no geodesic segment can be formed and distance_km is left NULL rather than approximated from a single point.

Sum of route_segments.csv RS002 only. Covers Bab el-Mandeb (CP002) to New Mangalore Port (PORT006). Does NOT cover Saudi Arabia (SUP001) to the export terminal Yanbu, or Yanbu through the Red Sea/Gulf of Aden to CP002 - none of those nodes have a sourced coordinate. Geodesic distance only, not a sailing distance. estimated_transit_days NULL for the same reason as RT001.

Sum of route_segments.csv RS003 + RS004 (Suez Canal to Bab el-Mandeb, then Bab el-Mandeb to Deendayal Port). This is the SUEZ_OR_SUMED branch_group's Suez alternative (chokepoint CP003) from route_nodes.csv. Does NOT cover the Mediterranean Sea node preceding CP003, which has no sourced coordinate. origin_node is intentionally blank: RT004 in routes.csv itself has no origin_supplier_id or origin_country, being defined by its transit segment rather than a single origin. Geodesic distance only, not a navigational sailing distance through the canal and Red Sea coastline. estimated_transit_days NULL - no vessel-speed or canal-transit-time assumption is sourced.

Equal to route_segments.csv RS005 (Bab el-Mandeb to Deendayal Port) only. This is the SUEZ_OR_SUMED branch_group's SUMED alternative (chokepoint CP004) from route_nodes.csv. CP004 (the SUMED Pipeline) has NULL coordinates in chokepoints.csv because it is a linear feature, not a point - so the pipeline's own transit length is NOT represented in this figure at all, and this value must not be compared directly against the via_suez variant's 5369.0 km as if they covered the same physical distance: the via_suez figure includes a Suez-Canal-to-Red-Sea leg that this variant omits entirely because its equivalent (the SUMED pipeline itself) has no sourced geometry. estimated_transit_days NULL for the same reason as the other rows.

Only one node in this route's chain (PORT012, Paradip Port) has a sourced coordinate; the origin (SUP005, Russian Federation) has none, and RT005 itself carries no chokepoint or determined corridor per routes.csv ('primary_corridor: not determined') - consistent with the Phase 1 finding (L4) that Russia's routing to India is unresolved. No segment is computable and none is invented.

Sum of route_segments.csv RS006 only (Cape of Good Hope to New Mangalore Port). Does NOT cover Nigeria (SUP006) to the Cape - no coordinate is sourced for SUP006 or the 'South Atlantic Ocean'/'Indian Ocean' labels. Geodesic distance only, not a sailing distance, and CP006's own coordinate is a headland landmark rather than the shipping lane (see chokepoints.csv). estimated_transit_days NULL - no vessel-speed assumption is sourced.

Sum of route_segments.csv RS007 only (Cape of Good Hope to New Mangalore Port) - numerically identical to RT006 because both routes share the same chokepoint and destination port; this is NOT a Brazil-to-India distance. Origin (SUP008, Brazil) has no sourced coordinate, so the Brazil-to-Cape leg is entirely unmodelled. estimated_transit_days NULL for the same reason as the other rows.

Only one node in this route's chain (PORT001, Deendayal Port) has a sourced coordinate; the origin (SUP009, United States of America) has none, and RT008 itself carries no chokepoint or determined corridor per routes.csv ('onward routing not determined') - consistent with the Phase 1 finding (L4) that the US routing to India is unresolved between a Cape of Good Hope path and a Suez path. No segment is computable and none is invented.
